move: two blurred colour bands sweep vertically past each other, screen-blended
how: On a navy base gradient, two 2880px-tall repeating-linear-gradient bands (green-cyan-yellow, and violet-pink at 55% opacity) are blurred 8-14px and screen-blended over the frame. Band A slides y from -1440 to 0 (exactly one repeat period) and band B slides from 720 to -720 over the full D, both with power1.inOut, so the sweep pushes through the frame and settles at the loop point with identical pixels. A large centred wordmark bobs y 6 to -6 and back with one sine yoyo cycle; a radial vignette and a small uppercase subline stay still.
adapt: Replace the two band colour stops and the navy base with the product palette, and the title and subline text. Keep the one-period travel distances so the band tiles seamlessly; ease can become none for a constant conveyor feel.
port: mount(el, shot) adds the base, two band divs, vignette and title inside el; animate(el, shot, D) returns the same timeline with the two band tweens over D and the title yoyo. The band heights assume a 720px frame; scale the 1440px period with the shot height.
caveats: power1.inOut means velocity dips to zero at the loop boundary, a visible breath rather than a constant sweep
blur(8px)/blur(14px) on 2880px-tall screen-blended layers is expensive
